utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, how many volunteers do we actually have for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve only heard we’ve got a small handful so far, but I can check with the sign-up table when I pass by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please do, and ask how many can handle tools versus just setup or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in for the repair drive—I can bring my toolkit and a spare drill if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’s perfect—yeah, bring both if you can, I keep forgetting what we already have lined up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it—I’ll bring both and toss in a box of assorted screws too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia, I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks have already dropped off a good pile of toasters and bikes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s encouraging, but I do hope someone’s keeping track of where everything’s being stored and who’s collecting it. If the pile gets much bigger, logistics could get messy fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—I heard Mara’s started a little sign-in sheet in the church hall, and Ben’s been hauling the bigger bits into the shed so they don’t clutter the entry.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Opal—just tell me what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—first I want to make a quick list of which houses on Maple and Cedar need repairs most urgently.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I can walk Maple this afternoon and note the urgent spots, then we can compare it with Cedar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting the word out about the repair drive—can you come by and maybe tell a few others too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by for a little while, and I’ll mention it to a couple of neighbors. I’m keeping things quiet these days, but I do want to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be wonderful, Uli—thank you. Even a little time and a couple of mentions will help the repair drive a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad we’re syncing up. For the repair drive, I’d love to lock in the volunteer list and pick a start time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s keep it simple: send me the volunteer names you have, and I’ll confirm by tonight. I’m good starting at 9 if that works for the group.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll send over the volunteer names this afternoon, and 9 works well on my end if the rest of the group is on board.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I pitch in, can you remind me which repairs we’re prioritizing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late—are we starting with the porch steps and the fence, or did the roof bump those up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—that’s what I was checking too. Let’s confirm whether the roof moved ahead of the porch steps and fence before we make plans.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times—what hours are you aiming for on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m aiming for late morning into early afternoon, probably around 10 to 2, so it doesn’t collide too badly with pickup. If that window works, I’d love your help coordinating around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window works well for me—I can help line things up around the school run and make sure pickup families know the timing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—do you know if they’ve picked a day for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not officially, but I’ve heard they’re leaning toward Saturday morning so more folks can make it. I can check with Maya and let you know as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense—Saturday morning would probably get the best turnout. Thanks, I’d appreciate it if you let me know once Maya confirms.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira—quick check, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but can you confirm the time and who’s bringing tools first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah—let’s call it Saturday at 10, and I’ll bring the basic tools. Can you check if Malik’s still bringing the drill?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help a little, if you still need hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s kind of you, Rey — I’m pretty sure we could use another pair of hands. I keep misplacing the sign-up sheet, but yes, please come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright. If you find the sheet, just tell me when and where to show up, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Cleo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive so everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking—I'll keep a tally of tape, gloves, and spare screws so we know what we're short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—I’ll keep telling folks the plan and let them know you’re tracking tape, gloves, and spare screws for the repair drive.
